name: UK weather warnings
summary: Yellow fog warnings across much of England and Wales; no amber or red warnings
state: The Met Office had eight yellow fog warnings in force at 05:40 UTC on 8 Nov, covering most English regions and Wales, and no amber or red warnings (Met Office). Fog warnings are short-lived and mainly affect travel.
for_you: Follow Met Office advice: allow extra time for journeys in fog and check before travelling.
why: Met Office warnings are the official signal for disruption to travel, power and safety in the UK.
drivers: Storms, heavy rain, snow and ice, heat, fog, thunderstorms.

rubric.watch: Widespread yellow or any amber warning in force.
rubric.normal: No warnings, or only localised yellow warnings.
